card.name: Linking words before a procedure to perform
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'by', 'followed by', 'include the' or 'should' that come just before a procedure or action to carry out. Mostly in overdose sections, ahead of gastric lavage, induced vomiting or activated charcoal.

modes.label: Overdose decontamination
modes.description: 'by' or 'followed by' right before gastric lavage, emesis or charcoal.
modes.example: This should include large volume gastric lavage followed<< by>> activated charcoal.

modes.label: Instructions to do a step
modes.description: A linking word or comma before an action verb in step-by-step directions.
modes.example: To get back to the console you<< should>> type :q; to find a phrase

card.writes: It favours verbs and nouns for carrying out an action (perform, inject, place) and disfavours verbs of stopping or increasing.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to name a procedure to carry out, such as stomach pumping after an overdose.
